prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: portrait 9:16 mobile baseball game background, 1080 x 1920 or equivalent 9:16 canvas.
Primary request: realistic nighttime baseball stadium from catcher's viewpoint looking toward a CENTERED EMPTY pitcher's mound. This is an environment-only backdrop.
Composition/framing: strict upright level camera; field horizon across y=22% of full image height. Center of the pitcher's mound and its visible top surface must be at x=50%, y=28%. The distant mound is small and realistically proportioned, approximately 18% of frame width, with clearly visible EMPTY top. Generous uninterrupted empty green grass from y=32% to y=75%, with no objects, actors, overlays, tiles, or grid on it. Home plate at x=50%, y=83%. Only a very subtle partial catcher glove peeking at the bottom-left edge and bottom edge. Realistic baseball field perspective and depth. The mound should feel distant, leaving the lower center open.
Lighting/mood: premium cinematic nighttime atmosphere, navy and teal stadium and grass with warm amber floodlights far to the sides; neutral white illumination on the mound and playing field so a later actor overlay will match. Keep upper center clear and dark enough for game UI added later.
Scene/backdrop: distant stadium stands and far indistinct crowd permitted, no discernible individuals.
Constraints: absolutely NO pitcher, NO players, NO people anywhere on the playing field, NO existing actor. NO text, letters, logos, digits, scoreboards with marks, watermarks, UI, game tiles, grid or HUD. Empty mound placement is the highest priority. Do not include an overlaid pitcher or game interface. No tilted camera, exaggerated foreground mound, or glaring light across the upper center.

Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: isolated transparent PNG game sprite, wide horizontal image approximately 1536 x 384.
Primary request: a single realistic pale maple baseball bat, clean cutout on a genuinely transparent background with actual alpha transparency.
Composition/framing: exact side view. Bat lies almost perfectly horizontal, long axis centered vertically. Small knob at LEFT, dark black/brown wrapped grip immediately to its right, taper through maple wood, broad rounded barrel at RIGHT. Entire bat fits within frame, with small even transparent margins around all edges. Proportions must be realistic for a regulation baseball bat. Handle and barrel must share a straight horizontal centerline, suitable for rotating around the handle in a browser game.
Materials/textures: bright pale maple wood with natural subtle grain, dark black/brown grip wrap, no branding.
Lighting/mood: neutral studio illumination, bright enough to read cleanly over a nighttime baseball stadium.
Constraints: one bat only. TRUE transparent background, not an opaque checkerboard or colored surface. No hands, people, text, logos, watermarks, ground, reflections or cast shadows outside the bat. Preserve soft antialiased alpha at the object edges. No dramatic diagonal angle, no cropping, no glow.
